It aggregates the shared server-owned readiness contracts — trading operator readiness, the operator inbox, the reconciliation break queue, and strategy run summaries — into one Launchpad surface and routes each work item to its owning workspace. All gate and severity truth stays server-side; sources that are unavailable degrade into per-panel error text rather than empty-looking rows.
